detail: PDGrapher genetic LINCS L1000 screens (10 lines); not Perturb-seq
Official within-line random 5-fold genetic splits (backward indices)
Median rank of true intervention + Recall@10 on the same ranking interface
ΔY = treated − diseased on the 10,716-gene PPI-intersected axis
Within each fold, genes restricted to those available to all compared methods before ranking
Train-fold mean ΔY by intervention gene (no held-out leakage into gallery)
Published genetic model / checkpoints scored under the identity-recovery ranking interface; training recipe unchanged beyond runtime stability settings
RevPert is gallery-native residual retrieval; PDGrapher is a GNN perturbation-discovery model — fair on ranking metrics, not architecture-matched
Resources never pooled; Essential primary baseline is Pearson, genetic primary baseline is official PDGrapher
